verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents automations as Internal Agent tasks that run on a schedule or on an event trigger, such as a GitHub PR merging. They are managed on an Automations page with templates, and the docs show natural-language event rules like 'When a ticket is about an enterprise account, transfer it…'. Actions need manual approval by default, but auto-approve can be enabled per task or automation, so triggered actions can run unattended. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of supported trigger event types beyond a single example, detail on how trigger conditions are expressed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
